changeSet.author: sDooley
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Execution] ( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PercentComplete] float NOT NULL, [Failures] [int] NOT NULL, ErrorMessage nvarchar(max) NULL, [StartedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CompletedOn] [datetime] NULL, [ProcessingStartedOn] [datetime] NULL, [Processing] [bit] NOT NULL, TriggeredByExecutionUid uniqueidentifier SPARSE NULL, TriggeredByMeasureUid uniqueidentifier SPARSE NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricsExecution] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] DESC ) ) END
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Execution' and COLUMN_NAME = 'ID') begin ALTER TABLE metrics.Execution add ID bigint identity not null end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Execution' and COLUMN_NAME = 'UpdatedOn') begin alter table metrics.Execution add UpdatedOn datetime null end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Execution' and COLUMN_NAME = 'LoopSecondsElapsed') begin alter table metrics.Execution add LoopSecondsElapsed int null end
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[metrics].[Execution]') AND name = 'ErrorMessage' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Execution] ALTER COLUMN [ErrorMessage] nvarchar(2500); END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN DROP TABLE [metrics].[Execution] END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[metrics].[Execution]') AND name = 'ErrorMessage' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Execution] ALTER COLUMN [ErrorMessage] nvarchar(max); END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS [CIX_MetricsExecution] ON [metrics].[Execution] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) GO
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsExecution') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricsExecution] ON [metrics].[Execution] ( ID ASC ) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricsExecution_UpdatedOnLoopElapsedSeconds') begin CREATE INDEX IX_MetricsExecution_UpdatedOnLoopElapsedSeconds ON metrics.Execution ( UpdatedOn, LoopSecondsElapsed ) end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricsExecution_Processing') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MetricsExecution_Processing] ON [metrics].[Execution] ( Processing DESC ) end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsExecution') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricsExecution] ON [metrics].[Execution] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricsExecution_UpdatedOnLoopElapsedSeconds') begin DROP INDEX [IX_MetricsExecution_UpdatedOnLoopElapsedSeconds] ON [metrics].[Execution] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricsExecution_Processing') begin DROP INDEX [IX_MetricsExecution_Processing] ON [metrics].[Execution] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
